items.title: GitHub Copilot code review: API support and new default effort level
items.summary_zh: GitHub 在 Changelog 中发布了 Copilot 代码评审的新能力：提供 API 支持，并调整了默认 effort level。虽然公开信息较短，但这表明 Copilot code review 正在从交互式产品功能转向可编程平台能力。
items.summary_en: GitHub announced via the Changelog that Copilot code review now has API support and a new default effort level. The public detail is brief, but the change suggests Copilot code review is moving from an interactive feature toward a programmable platform capability.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对于后端、平台和工程效率负责人，这意味着 AI 代码评审可以更容易嵌入 CI、合规检查、PR 路由和内部开发者门户。默认 effort level 的变化也说明模型推理预算、延迟与审查深度开始成为可运营的参数，而不只是 UI 选项。
items.why_it_matters_en: For backend, platform, and engineering productivity leaders, this means AI code review can be embedded more directly into CI, compliance checks, PR routing, and internal developer portals. The default effort-level change also signals that reasoning budget, latency, and review depth are becoming operational knobs rather than just UI settings.
key_takeaways_zh: 代码评审 API 化是从“Copilot 助手”走向“Copilot 可编排服务”的重要一步。
effort level 的默认值调整反映出供应商正在主动权衡评审质量、时延和成本。
key_takeaways_en: API-enabling code review is a meaningful step from 'Copilot assistant' toward 'Copilot as an orchestratable service.'
A default effort-level change reflects active vendor tuning across review quality, latency, and cost.

items.title: GitHub Copilot can now interact with desktop apps with computer use
items.summary_zh: GitHub 宣布 Copilot 现在可以通过 computer use 与桌面应用交互。这类能力通常意味着代理不仅能生成代码，还能跨 IDE、终端、浏览器或本地工具执行多步操作。
items.summary_en: GitHub announced that Copilot can now interact with desktop apps using computer-use capabilities. This typically means the agent can go beyond code generation and execute multi-step actions across IDEs, terminals, browsers, or local tools.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这对工程平台团队是强信号：未来的开发者工具链将不再只暴露 API，也要考虑 GUI 自动化、安全沙箱、权限边界、审计日志和失败恢复。它也会改变内部工具设计方式，因为很多尚未 API 化的流程现在可以先由桌面代理桥接。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a strong signal for platform teams: future developer tooling will need to account not only for APIs, but also GUI automation, sandboxing, permission boundaries, audit trails, and recovery from failed actions. It also changes internal tool design, because workflows that are not yet API-driven can now be bridged by desktop agents.
key_takeaways_zh: computer use 扩展了 AI 编码代理的执行面，从代码建议走向真实环境操作。
组织采用时需要优先评估权限控制、可观测性和桌面级安全策略。
key_takeaways_en: Computer use expands AI coding agents from suggestion systems into real environment operators.
Adoption requires early attention to permission control, observability, and desktop-level security policy.
